cross_batch_interpretation: The S&P batch's large positive addition-versus-deletion announcement-to-implementation separation did not replicate.
Extreme implementation-session whole-day volume did replicate for both additions and deletions.
The addition group underperformed over the first five post-implementation sessions, consistent with short reversal but not sufficient to identify an auction-pressure mechanism.
Longer-horizon addition performance is highly dispersed and mechanically selected from strong prior winners; it is not evidence of index causality.
limitations: One 12-security batch; group means are descriptive and receive no p-values.
The announcement time is exact, but daily OHLCV can trade only from the next regular-session open.
The implementation close is inferred from effectiveness before the following session open and the provider's quadruple-witching schedule.
Daily OHLCV cannot identify closing-auction imbalance, spread, auction-only volume, or implementation shortfall.
Yahoo Finance is a convenient pilot source, not a production market-data authority.
No point-in-time candidate universe or matched controls were constructed.
